assumptions_metadata.task_description: Update IPL team standings and match-summary KPIs (win points, margin type, super-over flags) from the official match results feed.

assumptions.assumption: team1 and team2 must be different teams.
toss_winner must equal either team1 or team2.
If winner is not null, it must equal team1 or team2.
team1 and team2 values must belong to the known 19-team vocabulary observed in this dataset.
toss_winner is not null.
result must be one of {'runs','wickets','tie','no result'}.
If result = 'no result', winner is null; otherwise winner is not null.
If result = 'tie', super_over = 'Y'.
If super_over = 'Y', result = 'tie'.
At least 95% of rows have result in {'runs','wickets'}.
If result = 'wickets', result_margin is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.
If result = 'runs', result_margin is an integer between 1 and 200 inclusive.
If result is 'tie' or 'no result', result_margin is null.
target_overs is between 5 and 20 inclusive.
If method = 'D/L', target_overs < 20.
If method is null, target_overs = 20.
At least 95% of matches have target_overs = 20.
date must be parseable as YYYY-MM-DD.
season equals the 4-digit year extracted from date.
season is between 2008 and 2024 inclusive.
toss_decision must be either 'bat' or 'field'.
toss_decision is not null.
At least 55% of toss_decision values are 'field'.
match_type must be one of {'League','Qualifier 1','Qualifier 2','Eliminator','Elimination Final','Semi Final','Final','3rd Place Play-Off'}.
match_type is not null.
At least 90% of matches are of type 'League'.

result.code:
import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_file = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

    # Basic normalization
    null_like = {None, np.nan, 'NA', 'NaN', 'na', 'n/a', 'NULL', 'Null', 'null', 'None', 'NullValue', ''}
    for col in df.columns:
        if df[col].dtype == 'object':
            df[col] = df[col].replace(list(null_like), np.nan)
            df[col] = df[col].astype('string')
            df[col] = df[col].str.strip()

    # Normalize categorical fields used in logic
    if 'result' in df.columns:
        df['result'] = df['result'].astype('string').str.lower().str.strip()
    if 'toss_decision' in df.columns:
        df['toss_decision'] = df['toss_decision'].astype('string').str.lower().str.strip()
    if 'super_over' in df.columns:
        df['super_over'] = df['super_over'].astype('string').str.upper().str.strip()

    # Coerce numerics
    for col in ['result_margin', 'target_runs', 'target_overs']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTIONS on result and winner/super_over relationships
    # ASSERTION_START
    valid_results = {'runs', 'wickets', 'tie', 'no result'}
    assert df['result'].isin(valid_results).all()
    assert (df['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets']).mean() >= 0.95)
    tie_mask = df['result'].eq('tie')
    so_mask = df['super_over'].eq('Y')
    assert (tie_mask == so_mask).all()
    assert df.loc[df['result'].eq('no result'), 'winner'].isna().all()
    assert df.loc[~df['result'].eq('no result'), 'winner'].notna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Date/season integrity checks before we use them for season-scoped standings
    # ASSERTION_START
    parsed_dates = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')
    assert parsed_dates.notna().all()
    season_num = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    assert season_num.notna().all()
    assert (season_num.astype(int) == parsed_dates.dt.year).all()
    assert ((season_num >= 2008) & (season_num <= 2024)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Use parsed types after validation
    df['season'] = season_num.astype(int)
    df['date_dt'] = parsed_dates

    # Toss decision integrity before using it to derive batting order
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['toss_decision'].notna().all()
    assert df['toss_decision'].isin(['bat', 'field']).all()
    assert ((df['toss_decision'] == 'field').mean() >= 0.55)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Match type validity before we optionally filter to League for standings
    # ASSERTION_START
    valid_match_types = {
        'League', 'Qualifier 1', 'Qualifier 2', 'Eliminator',
        'Elimination Final', 'Semi Final', 'Final', '3rd Place Play-Off'
    }
    assert df['match_type'].notna().all()
    assert df['match_type'].isin(valid_match_types).all()
    assert ((df['match_type'] == 'League').mean() >= 0.90)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Team relationships required for downstream winner/loser derivation and batting order
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
    assert df['toss_winner'].notna().all()
    assert ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
    non_null_winner_mask = df['winner'].notna()
    assert ((df.loc[non_null_winner_mask, 'winner'] == df.loc[non_null_winner_mask, 'team1']) | (df.loc[non_null_winner_mask, 'winner'] == df.loc[non_null_winner_mask, 'team2'])).all()
    observed_teams = set(pd.unique(pd.concat([df['team1'], df['team2']], ignore_index=True)))
    known_teams = {
        'Chennai Super Kings', 'Delhi Capitals', 'Delhi Daredevils', 'Kolkata Knight Riders',
        'Mumbai Indians', 'Rajasthan Royals', 'Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Kings XI Punjab',
        'Punjab Kings', 'Deccan Chargers', 'Kochi Tuskers Kerala', 'Pune Warriors',
        'Sunrisers Hyderabad', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants',
        'Gujarat Lions', 'Gujarat Titans', 'Lucknow Super Giants', 'Pune Warriors India'
    }
    assert len(observed_teams) <= 19
    assert observed_teams.issubset(known_teams)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Target overs and method consistency before using target_overs to tag reduced-overs fixtures
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['target_overs'] >= 5) & (df['target_overs'] <= 20)).all()
    dl_mask2 = df['method'].fillna('').str.upper().eq('D/L')
    null_method_mask2 = df['method'].isna()
    assert (df.loc[dl_mask2, 'target_overs'] < 20).all()
    assert (df.loc[null_method_mask2, 'target_overs'] == 20).all()
    assert ((df['target_overs'] == 20).mean() >= 0.95)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Result-margin constraints before formatting margin text
    # ASSERTION_START
    wk_mask = df['result'].eq('wickets')
    rn_mask = df['result'].eq('runs')
    assert df.loc[wk_mask, 'result_margin'].notna().all() and df.loc[rn_mask, 'result_margin'].notna().all()
    finite_margins = df.loc[wk_mask | rn_mask, 'result_margin']
    assert np.isfinite(finite_margins).all()
    assert (np.floor(finite_margins) == finite_margins).all()
    assert ((df.loc[wk_mask, 'result_margin'] >= 1) & (df.loc[wk_mask, 'result_margin'] <= 10)).all()
    assert ((df.loc[rn_mask, 'result_margin'] >= 1) & (df.loc[rn_mask, 'result_margin'] <= 200)).all()
    assert df.loc[df['result'].isin(['tie', 'no result']), 'result_margin'].isna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Derive batting order from toss for KPIs that depend on who chased
    bat_first_team = np.where(
        df['toss_decision'].eq('bat'),
        df['toss_winner'],
        np.where(df['toss_winner'].eq(df['team1']), df['team2'], df['team1'])
    )
    df['bat_first_team'] = bat_first_team
    df['chasing_team'] = np.where(df['bat_first_team'].eq(df['team1']), df['team2'], df['team1'])

    # Compute margin_type text (depends on integer constraints above)
    margin_type = np.where(
        df['result'].eq('runs'),
        df['result_margin'].astype('Int64').astype(str) + ' runs',
        np.where(
            df['result'].eq('wickets'),
            df['result_margin'].astype('Int64').astype(str) + ' wickets',
            pd.NA
        )
    )
    df['margin_type'] = margin_type

    # Points allocation per team per match
    df['points_team1'] = np.select(
        [df['result'].eq('no result'), df['winner'].eq(df['team1'])],
        [1, 2],
        default=0
    )
    df['points_team2'] = np.select(
        [df['result'].eq('no result'), df['winner'].eq(df['team2'])],
        [1, 2],
        default=0
    )

    # Prepare match-level KPIs output
    match_kpis_cols = [
        'id', 'season', 'date', 'match_type', 'city', 'venue',
        'team1', 'team2', 'toss_winner', 'toss_decision',
        'winner', 'result', 'result_margin', 'margin_type',
        'super_over', 'method', 'target_overs',
        'bat_first_team', 'chasing_team', 'points_team1', 'points_team2'
    ]
    # Ensure columns exist in case some optional ones are missing in feed
    match_kpis_cols = [c for c in match_kpis_cols if c in df.columns or c in ['margin_type', 'bat_first_team', 'chasing_team', 'points_team1', 'points_team2']]
    match_kpis = df[match_kpis_cols].copy()

    # Compute team standings (League matches only) per season
    league_mask = df['match_type'].eq('League')
    league_df = df.loc[league_mask].copy()

    team1_rec = pd.DataFrame({
        'season': league_df['season'].values,
        'team': league_df['team1'].values,
        'played': 1,
        'wins': (league_df['winner'] == league_df['team1']).astype(int).values,
        'losses': ((~league_df['result'].eq('no result')) & (league_df['winner'] == league_df['team2'])).astype(int).values,
        'no_results': (league_df['result'].eq('no result')).astype(int).values,
        'points': league_df['points_team1'].values
    })

    team2_rec = pd.DataFrame({
        'season': league_df['season'].values,
        'team': league_df['team2'].values,
        'played': 1,
        'wins': (league_df['winner'] == league_df['team2']).astype(int).values,
        'losses': ((~league_df['result'].eq('no result')) & (league_df['winner'] == league_df['team1'])).astype(int).values,
        'no_results': (league_df['result'].eq('no result')).astype(int).values,
        'points': league_df['points_team2'].values
    })

    standings_long = pd.concat([team1_rec, team2_rec], ignore_index=True)

    standings = (
        standings_long
        .groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)
        .agg(played=('played', 'sum'), wins=('wins', 'sum'), losses=('losses', 'sum'), no_results=('no_results', 'sum'), points=('points', 'sum'))
    )

    # Tie-breaker proxy: prioritize higher wins then points; sort within season
    standings = standings.sort_values(by=['season', 'points', 'wins', 'played'], ascending=[True, False, False, True])

    match_kpis.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'match_kpis.csv'), index=False)
    standings.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'team_standings.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_file = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

    # Basic normalization
    null_like = {None, np.nan, 'NA', 'NaN', 'na', 'n/a', 'NULL', 'Null', 'null', 'None', 'NullValue', ''}
    for col in df.columns:
        if df[col].dtype == 'object':
            df[col] = df[col].replace(list(null_like), np.nan)
            df[col] = df[col].astype('string')
            df[col] = df[col].str.strip()

    # Normalize categorical fields used in logic
    if 'result' in df.columns:
        df['result'] = df['result'].astype('string').str.lower().str.strip()
    if 'toss_decision' in df.columns:
        df['toss_decision'] = df['toss_decision'].astype('string').str.lower().str.strip()
    if 'super_over' in df.columns:
        df['super_over'] = df['super_over'].astype('string').str.upper().str.strip()

    # Coerce numerics
    for col in ['result_margin', 'target_runs', 'target_overs']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTIONS on result and winner/super_over relationships
    # ASSERTION_START
    valid_results = {'runs', 'wickets', 'tie', 'no result'}
    assert df['result'].isin(valid_results).all()
    assert (df['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets']).mean() >= 0.95)
    tie_mask = df['result'].eq('tie')
    so_mask = df['super_over'].eq('Y')
    assert (tie_mask == so_mask).all()
    assert df.loc[df['result'].eq('no result'), 'winner'].isna().all()
    assert df.loc[~df['result'].eq('no result'), 'winner'].notna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Date/season integrity checks before we use them for season-scoped standings
    # ASSERTION_START
    parsed_dates = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')
    assert parsed_dates.notna().all()
    season_num = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    assert season_num.notna().all()
    assert (season_num.astype(int) == parsed_dates.dt.year).all()
    assert ((season_num >= 2008) & (season_num <= 2024)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Use parsed types after validation
    df['season'] = season_num.astype(int)
    df['date_dt'] = parsed_dates

    # Toss decision integrity before using it to derive batting order
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df['toss_decision'].notna().all()
    assert df['toss_decision'].isin(['bat', 'field']).all()
    assert ((df['toss_decision'] == 'field').mean() >= 0.55)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Match type validity before we optionally filter to League for standings
    # ASSERTION_START
    valid_match_types = {
        'League', 'Qualifier 1', 'Qualifier 2', 'Eliminator',
        'Elimination Final', 'Semi Final', 'Final', '3rd Place Play-Off'
    }
    assert df['match_type'].notna().all()
    assert df['match_type'].isin(valid_match_types).all()
    assert ((df['match_type'] == 'League').mean() >= 0.90)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Team relationships required for downstream winner/loser derivation and batting order
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
    assert df['toss_winner'].notna().all()
    assert ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
    non_null_winner_mask = df['winner'].notna()
    assert ((df.loc[non_null_winner_mask, 'winner'] == df.loc[non_null_winner_mask, 'team1']) | (df.loc[non_null_winner_mask, 'winner'] == df.loc[non_null_winner_mask, 'team2'])).all()
    observed_teams = set(pd.unique(pd.concat([df['team1'], df['team2']], ignore_index=True)))
    known_teams = {
        'Chennai Super Kings', 'Delhi Capitals', 'Delhi Daredevils', 'Kolkata Knight Riders',
        'Mumbai Indians', 'Rajasthan Royals', 'Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Kings XI Punjab',
        'Punjab Kings', 'Deccan Chargers', 'Kochi Tuskers Kerala', 'Pune Warriors',
        'Sunrisers Hyderabad', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants',
        'Gujarat Lions', 'Gujarat Titans', 'Lucknow Super Giants', 'Pune Warriors India'
    }
    assert len(observed_teams) <= 19
    assert observed_teams.issubset(known_teams)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Target overs and method consistency before using target_overs to tag reduced-overs fixtures
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['target_overs'] >= 5) & (df['target_overs'] <= 20)).all()
    dl_mask2 = df['method'].fillna('').str.upper().eq('D/L')
    null_method_mask2 = df['method'].isna()
    assert (df.loc[dl_mask2, 'target_overs'] < 20).all()
    assert (df.loc[null_method_mask2, 'target_overs'] == 20).all()
    assert ((df['target_overs'] == 20).mean() >= 0.95)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Result-margin constraints before formatting margin text
    # ASSERTION_START
    wk_mask = df['result'].eq('wickets')
    rn_mask = df['result'].eq('runs')
    assert df.loc[wk_mask, 'result_margin'].notna().all() and df.loc[rn_mask, 'result_margin'].notna().all()
    finite_margins = df.loc[wk_mask | rn_mask, 'result_margin']
    assert np.isfinite(finite_margins).all()
    assert (np.floor(finite_margins) == finite_margins).all()
    assert ((df.loc[wk_mask, 'result_margin'] >= 1) & (df.loc[wk_mask, 'result_margin'] <= 10)).all()
    assert ((df.loc[rn_mask, 'result_margin'] >= 1) & (df.loc[rn_mask, 'result_margin'] <= 200)).all()
    assert df.loc[df['result'].isin(['tie', 'no result']), 'result_margin'].isna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Derive batting order from toss for KPIs that depend on who chased
    bat_first_team = np.where(
        df['toss_decision'].eq('bat'),
        df['toss_winner'],
        np.where(df['toss_winner'].eq(df['team1']), df['team2'], df['team1'])
    )
    df['bat_first_team'] = bat_first_team
    df['chasing_team'] = np.where(df['bat_first_team'].eq(df['team1']), df['team2'], df['team1'])

    # Compute margin_type text (depends on integer constraints above)
    margin_type = np.where(
        df['result'].eq('runs'),
        df['result_margin'].astype('Int64').astype(str) + ' runs',
        np.where(
            df['result'].eq('wickets'),
            df['result_margin'].astype('Int64').astype(str) + ' wickets',
            pd.NA
        )
    )
    df['margin_type'] = margin_type

    # Points allocation per team per match
    df['points_team1'] = np.select(
        [df['result'].eq('no result'), df['winner'].eq(df['team1'])],
        [1, 2],
        default=0
    )
    df['points_team2'] = np.select(
        [df['result'].eq('no result'), df['winner'].eq(df['team2'])],
        [1, 2],
        default=0
    )

    # Prepare match-level KPIs output
    match_kpis_cols = [
        'id', 'season', 'date', 'match_type', 'city', 'venue',
        'team1', 'team2', 'toss_winner', 'toss_decision',
        'winner', 'result', 'result_margin', 'margin_type',
        'super_over', 'method', 'target_overs',
        'bat_first_team', 'chasing_team', 'points_team1', 'points_team2'
    ]
    # Ensure columns exist in case some optional ones are missing in feed
    match_kpis_cols = [c for c in match_kpis_cols if c in df.columns or c in ['margin_type', 'bat_first_team', 'chasing_team', 'points_team1', 'points_team2']]
    match_kpis = df[match_kpis_cols].copy()

    # Compute team standings (League matches only) per season
    league_mask = df['match_type'].eq('League')
    league_df = df.loc[league_mask].copy()

    team1_rec = pd.DataFrame({
        'season': league_df['season'].values,
        'team': league_df['team1'].values,
        'played': 1,
        'wins': (league_df['winner'] == league_df['team1']).astype(int).values,
        'losses': ((~league_df['result'].eq('no result')) & (league_df['winner'] == league_df['team2'])).astype(int).values,
        'no_results': (league_df['result'].eq('no result')).astype(int).values,
        'points': league_df['points_team1'].values
    })

    team2_rec = pd.DataFrame({
        'season': league_df['season'].values,
        'team': league_df['team2'].values,
        'played': 1,
        'wins': (league_df['winner'] == league_df['team2']).astype(int).values,
        'losses': ((~league_df['result'].eq('no result')) & (league_df['winner'] == league_df['team1'])).astype(int).values,
        'no_results': (league_df['result'].eq('no result')).astype(int).values,
        'points': league_df['points_team2'].values
    })

    standings_long = pd.concat([team1_rec, team2_rec], ignore_index=True)

    standings = (
        standings_long
        .groupby(['season', 'team'], as_index=False)
        .agg(played=('played', 'sum'), wins=('wins', 'sum'), losses=('losses', 'sum'), no_results=('no_results', 'sum'), points=('points', 'sum'))
    )

    # Tie-breaker proxy: prioritize higher wins then points; sort within season
    standings = standings.sort_values(by=['season', 'points', 'wins', 'played'], ascending=[True, False, False, True])

    match_kpis.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'match_kpis.csv'), index=False)
    standings.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'team_standings.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
